members.hint: People who work at the register sign in with a PIN on the phone. Only the owner manages admins.
members.newHint: Create someone who will use the register with a PIN, without a Google account.
members.disableHint: A disabled person cannot sign in, but their history is kept.

pin.label: PIN (4 to 6 digits)
pin.mustChange: Ask them to change it when they sign in
pin.once: Write it down or tell them now: for security it is stored encrypted and cannot be shown again. If it is forgotten, set a new one.

invitations.hint: An invitation lets someone with a Google account join the business with the chosen role.
invitations.copyFailed: Could not copy: select it and copy it by hand.
invitations.revokeBody: Code {{code}} will stop working. Whoever already joined keeps their access.
invitations.createdHint: Share the code or the link with the person. They open it with their Google account.
invitations.maxUses: How many people can use it
invitations.emailHint: If you enter it, only that Google account can accept the invitation.

devices.revokeBody: “{{name}}” will stop syncing and will need to be linked again.
devices.revokePending_one: It has {{count}} operation not sent yet; it stays on the phone but will not arrive here until it is linked again.
devices.revokePending_other: It has {{count}} operations not sent yet; they stay on the phone but will not arrive here until it is linked again.
devices.linkHint: On the new phone open the app and choose “Link this phone”: it shows a short code. Type it here.
devices.empty: There are no linked phones yet.
